product_name: Standardized Enriched Curcumin & Piperine Nano-Emulsion Spray
statutory_definition: Drugs & Cosmetics Rules, 1945 (Rule 2(eb)) - Purified, standardized fraction of medicinal plant extract with proven safety & efficacy.
formulation_origin: Botanical extract of Curcuma longa and Piper nigrum (Novel extraction process)

patents.patentability_rationale: Overcomes Section 3(p) bar because it is not a crude traditional formulation. Overcomes Section 3(e) by demonstrating non-obvious synergistic bioavailability enhancement (>300% over individual extracts).
patents.prior_art_risk: High TKDL presence for crude Curcuma + Piper combination; patent must focus strictly on the specific purified fraction ratio and nano-emulsion process parameters.

trademark.recommended_class: Class 5 (Pharmaceutical and Veterinary Preparations; Dietary Supplements)
trademark.gaps: Must avoid descriptive Sanskrit names (e.g., 'Haridra Bio-Boost') under Sec 9 of Trade Marks Act 1999.

geographical_indication.linked_gi: Kandhamal Haldi (GI Tagged source for high curcumin content)

abs_compliance_india.bda_applicability: Applicable under Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (Amended 2023) & 2024 Rules.
abs_compliance_india.exemption_status: Not exempt. Commercial utilization of bio-resources by non-practitioner MSME/Startup.
abs_compliance_india.required_forms: Form I (Access to Biological Resources) to National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) prior to commercial production.

international_ip_and_market_access.wipo_gratk_treaty_2024: Mandatory disclosure of India as the Country of Origin of Curcuma longa in PCT patent applications.
international_ip_and_market_access.us_market_access: USFDA Botanical Drug Development Guidance (NDA path required for therapeutic claims).
international_ip_and_market_access.eu_market_access: EU THMPD (Directive 2004/24/EC) or Well-Established Medicinal Use route.

statutory_citations: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge (2024), Article 3
